name: FL-17
label: Safe R

key_factors: R+10 district lean with an incumbent Republican running
Steube's large fundraising edge ($2.1M cash vs $24K)
Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~7%
No polls or expert ratings signal a competitive race
model.rationale: The R+10 district, Steube's incumbency, and his overwhelming financial advantage leave the Democrat with no visible path, and markets agree at roughly a 7% Democratic win chance. With no polls or expert ratings suggesting competition, the forecast stays near the fundamentals.
model.watch: Any late independent spending or polling showing Steube under 55% would be the first sign of a real contest.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Greg Steube, the Republican incumbent, is heavily favored in this southwest Florida district that leans about ten points Republican. He has raised over $1.3 million and holds more than $2 million on hand, while Democratic nominee Matthew Montavon has raised under $100,000 with minimal cash available. An independent candidate trails far behind in both money and profile.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, and prediction markets give the Democrat only about a 7% chance of winning. The fundamentals, the money gap, and the incumbent's renomination all point the same direction, making this one of the safer Republican-held House seats on the map this cycle.
